packs.name: Kenney Furniture Kit (2.0)
packs.license_evidence_url: https://kenney.nl/assets/furniture-kit (page states 'Creative Commons CC0'); License.txt inside zip: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
packs.format: GLB (Models/GLTF format), plus FBX/OBJ/DAE/STL and PNG previews
packs.recolourable: n/a (props). Untextured flat-colour materials named 'wood','metal','metalDark','carpet' etc, so any piece recolours by swapping the named material
packs.notes: 140 models, the backbone of the lane: desks (straight + corner), desk chair, flat monitor, keyboard, mouse, laptop, vintage CRT-style TV (televisionVintage), three sofa variants, single bed (mattress stand-in), bookcases (a closed bookcase recoloured dark is a passable server cabinet), small/large fridges, table/floor/wall lamps, boxes, plus wall/floor/doorway/window tiles for the room shell. Flat-shaded, untextured, uniform scale, all rest on y=0. No server rack, whiteboard or power strip in this kit. Only the 'Models/GLTF format' folder (2.1 MB) is needed; the FBX/OBJ/DAE/STL folders and the 700 preview PNGs can be dropped later. No rigged content.

packs.name: KayKit Furniture Bits (1.0)
packs.license_evidence_url: https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Furniture-Bits-1.0/blob/main/LICENSE.txt (states 'License: (Creative Commons Zero, CC0) http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/'); same file at addons/kaykit_furniture_bits/... in the download
packs.format: glTF (.gltf + .bin, single shared texture atlas furniturebits_texture.png), plus OBJ
packs.recolourable: n/a (props). All pieces share one material 'furniture_texture' bound to a palette atlas, so recolouring means editing the atlas or swapping the material
packs.notes: Fetched from KayKit's official GitHub mirror (zipball of main). 53 models: couch/armchair, beds, tables, chairs, stools, two shelf families, cabinets, standing and table lamps, rugs, books, picture frames, cacti. Chunkier, slightly more toy-like proportions than Kenney; good for the lounge corner (couch + rug + standing lamp). Textured via a small palette atlas rather than flat vertex colours, so it mixes with Kenney best if the lighting is flat. No computers or electronics.

packs.name: KayKit Space Base Bits (1.0)
packs.format: glTF (.gltf + .bin, shared atlas spacebits_texture.png), plus OBJ
packs.recolourable: n/a (props), single shared material bound to spacebits_texture.png
packs.notes: Marginal for this lane, kept because it is tiny (4.4 MB) and CC0-verified. It is a planetary-base kit (terrain, tunnels, landers, trucks), not an interior kit, but the stacked cargo/containers pass as equipment crates and 'structure_tall' / 'containers_*' are candidate bodies for a server rack if recoloured dark with an emissive strip. No consoles, screens or racks. Safe to delete if the set needs the space.

packs.name: poly.pizza singles: workstations & den furniture
packs.source_url: https://poly.pizza (individual CC0 models; see MANIFEST.json for each model page)
packs.license_evidence_url: Each model page linked in MANIFEST.json shows 'Public Domain (CC0)' with https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/; the download script checked that URL on every model page before fetching (all 41 verified, 'license_verified_on_model_page': true). Creator listings also state licence 'CC0 1.0': https://poly.pizza/u/Quaternius, https://poly.pizza/u/CreativeTrio, https://poly.pizza/u/Armory_3D, https://poly.pizza/u/iPoly3D
packs.recolourable: n/a (props). Quaternius items use named flat materials (e.g. Computer Large: 'Orange','Grey','Screen','MetalLight'), CreativeTrio items use one material with a small palette texture
packs.notes: 41 hand-picked single GLBs (2 MB total) filling gaps Kenney lacks: Quaternius 'Computer Large' and 'Scifi Computer' are floor-standing console/mainframe units and the best server-rack stand-ins found (flat-coloured with a separate 'Screen' material for an emissive glow); iPoly3D 'CPU' is a PC tower; Quaternius 'Cable'/'Cable Long' are loose floor cable runs; 'Damaged Couch' is the den couch; Kenney 'Bedroll' + Quaternius 'Pallet'/'Bed Single' make a floor mattress; 'Can Fridge' is a mini fridge full of drinks; 'Wall Corkboard' and 'Ad Board' are the closest CC0 whiteboards (recolour the face white); two desk lamps and a floor lamp; two spare desks/office chair; shelves and a books bookcase. NOT found under CC0: a true 19-inch server rack, a power strip, a router. Styles are mixed (Quaternius flat-shaded, CreativeTrio palette-textured, Armory_3D smooth) but all low-poly and unlit-friendly. OVERLAP: the 'polypizza-hacker-props' folder downloaded by another lane already contains ~14 of these same models (both monitors, both computers, CPU, cables, TVs, corkboard, ad board, shelf-tall, printer, mouse); dedupe by poly.pizza id when merging.

rejected: Quaternius Furniture Pack (https://quaternius.com/packs/furniture.html): CC0, but 2017 FBX/OBJ/Blend only and the download is a Google Drive folder (not curl-scriptable); its useful pieces (couches, fridge, beds, lamps, shelves) were taken individually as GLBs from poly.pizza instead.

Quaternius Cyberpunk Game Kit (https://quaternius.com/packs/cyberpunkgamekit.html): CC0 but Drive-folder download and mostly platformer/robot content; the relevant props (Computer, Computer Large, Cables, TV, Signs) were taken as poly.pizza GLBs, and another lane already has it at src/quaternius-cyberpunk-game-kit.

Quaternius Sci-Fi Essentials Kit (https://quaternius.itch.io/sci-fi-essentials-kit): CC0 (itch page shows 'Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal'), FBX/OBJ/glTF, but the free Standard zip is 159 MB, over the 120 MB lane cap, and contents are robots/guns/crates rather than racks.

Quaternius Modular Sci-Fi Megakit (https://quaternius.itch.io/modular-sci-fi-megakit): CC0, Standard zip 46 MB (glTF), but it is walls/floors/columns/doors/aliens with no listed consoles or racks, and the whole Assets/src tree is already ~240 MB across lanes; itch download needs the logged-out /file/<upload_id> POST flow which the page markup did not expose. Worth revisiting only if a sci-fi corridor look is wanted.

poly.pizza 'server rack' / 'server' / 'router' / 'power strip' searches with the CC0 filter: no matches (all real server-rack models on poly.pizza are CC-BY 3.0, e.g. /m/0NOoJkllvPB, /m/0fdEJlRndTB, /m/4TZXM3lO5KK, and were skipped for attribution).

iPoly3D 'LowPoly Server Room Props' (Unity Asset Store pack surfaced by poly.pizza search): license not stated as CC0 on any page I could verify; skipped. Their individual CC0 uploads (CPU, RAM, SSD, PCB, Electronics Board) are fine and CPU was taken.
Kenney Mini Arcade / Retro Urban Kit / Modular Buildings / Survival Kit: CC0 and zip links found (mini-arcade already fetched by another lane), but out of the workstations lane.
Kenney search for a dedicated 'Office' kit: none exists; the Furniture Kit is Kenney's office/computer coverage.
